status: Simple native Plinth; supersedes all earlier Plinth silhouettes
geometry: Standalone: three stone cuboids; base/cap: two; shaft: one. Four flat carved socket faces on every form. No bevels, raised bars or corner strips.
preservation: Spellstone, offerings, independent stored sockets, recipes, waterlogging and shaping are unchanged. Plinth surface is flat at y14/16; foot/cap width 12/16 and shaft width 10/16.
textures: Existing vanilla masonry/carved tiles; no raster changes. Fixed UV phase across joins; native Quartz/Purpur pillar shaft.
